info.description: This API provides endpoints for managing rooms and categories.
info.title: Webby.RoomService

get.description:
Retrieve a **paginated** list of room categories. Supports optional **search** by name.

**Query Parameters Fallback:**
* Invalid, missing, or non-numeric `page` values will default to **1**.
* Invalid, missing, or non-numeric `limit` values (<1) will default to **10**. Limits >100 are capped at **100**.
* `search`: optional string to filter categories by name (case-insensitive)

post.description:
Create a new room category for organizing rooms.

**Validation Rules:**
* Name is **required** (cannot be null, empty, or whitespace-only)
* Name length must be **2-50 characters**
* Category name must be **unique** (409 Conflict if already exists)

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input data: name missing, empty, too short (<2), too long (>50), or whitespace-only. Also: malformed JSON, wrong Content-Type

delete.description:
Delete a room category by ID. **Permanent action — cannot be undone.**

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format in path

put.description:
Update an existing room category by ID. Only the **name** field is updateable.

**Validation Rules:**
* Name is **required** (cannot be null, empty, or whitespace-only)
* Name length must be **2-50 characters**

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input: name missing, empty, too short (<2), too long (>50), whitespace-only, invalid UUID in path, or malformed JSON

post.description:
Create a new room with a name, **category ID**, privacy setting, and optional **thumbnail**.

**Validation Rules:**
* `name`: **required**, 2-50 characters, cannot be null/empty/whitespace-only
* `categoryId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format
* `isPrivate`: **required**, must be valid boolean ("true" or "false")
* `thumbnail`: optional file upload, max 2MB

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* The authenticated user becomes the **room host (creator)**

400.description: Invalid input: name empty/too short/too long, invalid categoryId UUID, invalid isPrivate boolean, file too large or missing required fields

delete.description:
Delete a room by ID. **Permanent action — cannot be undone.**

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* **Only the room host** can delete this room

400.description: Invalid UUID format in path

403.description: Not authorized - only the room creator can delete

get.description:
Retrieve a room by its ID.

**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room creator (host)** can retrieve the room by ID

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format in path

403.description: Access denied - only the room creator can retrieve

put.description:
Update a room's name, **category ID**, privacy setting, and **thumbnail** by ID.

**Validation Rules:**
* `name`: **required**, 2-50 characters, cannot be null/empty/whitespace-only
* `categoryId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format
* `isPrivate`: **required**, must be valid boolean ("true" or "false")
* `thumbnail`: optional file upload, max 2MB

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* **Only the room host** can update this room

400.description: Invalid input: name validation failed, invalid UUID, invalid boolean, file too large, or missing required fields

403.description: Not authorized - only the room creator can update

get.description:
Retrieve a **paginated** list of members for a specific room. Supports optional **search** by username.

**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric
* `search`: **optional**, filters members by username (case-insensitive partial match)

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format or query parameters

post.description:
Add users to a room's member list. **This operation updates the room membership immediately.**

**Request Body Validation:**
* `userIds` is **required**
* `userIds` must contain at least **1** UUID
* Every entry in `userIds` must be a valid UUID v4 format

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room host** can add members

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input: missing or empty userIds, invalid UUID format

403.description: Not authorized - only host can add members

delete.description:
Remove a user from a room's member list. **This action cannot be undone.**

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `memberId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (member user ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room host** can remove members
* The host **cannot remove themselves** from the room

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format

403.description: Not authorized - only host can remove members

delete.summary: Remove a member from a room

patch.description:
Add or subtract points for a room member. Points are applied as a **delta** value.

**Request Body Validation:**
* `points`: **required**, integer value (positive to add, negative to subtract)

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `memberId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (member user ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room host** can update member points

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input: missing or non-integer points value, invalid UUID format

403.description: Not authorized - only host can update points

get.description:
Retrieve the playback queue for a room with enriched media data.
Pagination is based on individual videos: standalone videos count as 1, each video inside a playlist counts as 1.
Playlists are returned with their `children` truncated to the videos that fall within the current page.

**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can view the queue

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format or invalid query parameters

403.description: Access denied - only room members can view the queue

post.description:
Add a video or playlist to the room's playback queue.

**Request Body Validation:**
* `entityId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format
* `entityType`: **required**, must be either "video" or "playlist"

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can add items to the queue

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input: bad UUID format, invalid entityType (must be 'video' or 'playlist')

403.description: Access denied - only room members can add to queue

delete.description:
Remove a video or playlist from the room's playback queue.

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `itemId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (queue item ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can remove items from the queue

**Important:**
* Only a **standalone video** or the **playlist itself** can be deleted — individual videos within a playlist **cannot** be deleted separately

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid UUID format in path

403.description: Access denied - only room members can remove from queue

get.description:
Retrieve a **paginated** list of all rooms created by the authenticated user.

**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**
* Returns **only** the authenticated user's rooms
* List includes both public and private rooms owned by the user

400.description: Invalid query parameters: page or limit not numeric, or outside valid range

get.description:
Retrieve a **paginated** list of all publicly visible rooms in the system.

**Query Parameter Validation:**
* `page`: **optional** (default: 1), must be >= 1, must be numeric
* `limit`: **optional** (default: 10), must be 1-100, must be numeric
* `search`: **optional**, filters rooms by name (case-insensitive partial match)
* `category`: **optional**, filters rooms by category ID (UUID v4 format)

**Security Note:**
* Returns **only** public rooms (private rooms are excluded)
* Pagination prevents excessive data retrieval

parameters.description: Filter by category ID (UUID v4 format)
parameters.name: category

schema.description: Filter by category ID (UUID v4 format)

400.description: Invalid query parameters: page or limit not numeric, or outside valid range

post.description:
Create a new vote (poll or next_video) in a room. The vote starts immediately upon creation.

**Request Body Validation:**
* `type`: **required**, must be either "poll" or "next_video"
* `voteText`: **required**, 1-500 characters, question displayed to room members
* `durationSeconds`: **required**, between 60 (1 minute) and 604800 (7 days)
* `choices`: **required**, array of 2-20 choice items
  * Each choice requires a `name` (display label)
  * For "next_video" type, each choice should reference a `queueItemId`

**Vote Types:**
* `poll` — text poll created by host with arbitrary choices
* `next_video` — vote for the next queue item to play; the winning choice's queue item is moved to the top of the queue

**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room host** can create votes

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input: missing type/voteText/choices, invalid durationSeconds range, fewer than 2 or more than 20 choices

403.description: Access denied - only room host can create votes

get.description:
List all votes (polls and next_video) for a room. Returns each vote with full details including choices, percentages, expiry, and the current user's selection.

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can view the vote list

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid room ID format (UUID v4 required)

403.description: Access denied - only room members can view votes

get.description:
Get detailed information about a specific vote including choices with vote counts, percentages, expiry status, winner (if expired), and the current user's selection.

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `voteId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (vote ID)

**Response Details:**
* `isExpired`: computed from `createdAt + durationSeconds`
* `userVotedChoiceId`: the choice the current user voted for (null if not voted)
* `winnerId`: set only for expired "next_video" votes — tie-broken by host's double vote, then first candidate

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can view vote details

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid ID format (UUID v4 required)

403.description: Access denied - only room members can view vote details

delete.description:
Delete a vote and all associated choices and user votes. **Permanent action — cannot be undone.**

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `voteId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (vote ID)

**Access Rules:**
* Only the **room host** can delete votes

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid ID format (UUID v4 required)

403.description: Access denied - only the room host can delete votes

post.description:
Cast a vote for a specific choice. Each user can only vote **once** per vote.

**Request Body Validation:**
* `choiceId`: **required**, must be a valid UUID v4 format (choice ID)

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `voteId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (vote ID)

**Business Rules:**
* The vote must be **active** (not expired) to accept votes
* A user who has already voted will receive a **409 Conflict** response
* Returns updated vote details with recalculated percentages

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can cast votes

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid input: bad UUID format or vote has expired

403.description: Access denied - only room members can cast votes

409.description: Conflict: user has already voted on this vote

delete.description:
Remove the current user's vote from an active vote (unvote).

**Path Parameter Validation:**
* `id`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (room ID)
* `voteId`: must be a valid UUID v4 format (vote ID)

**Business Rules:**
* The vote must be **active** (not expired) to allow unvoting
* The user must have **previously voted** on this vote
* Returns updated vote details with recalculated percentages

**Access Rules:**
* Only **room members** can remove their votes

**Security Note:**
* This action **requires authentication**

400.description: Invalid ID format or vote has expired

403.description: Access denied - only room members can unvote

404.description: Vote not found or user hasn't voted
